intent_en: Compare the 2018 CEO compensation at General Motors, Volkswagen, and Toyota, and determine how the three levels rank against one another.
narration_support: You can see what a uniquely American phenomenon this is when you compare the compensation for General Motors CEO with her counterparts at Volkswagen in Germany and Toyota in Japan. And you can see part of the reason for this gap when you look at how much of their profits these people have earned.
narrative_goal: Show that the General Motors CEO received unusually high compensation in 2018 compared with her counterparts at Volkswagen and Toyota.
current_model_input: Compare the 2018 CEO compensation at General Motors, Volkswagen, and Toyota, and determine how the three levels rank against one another.
